coverage_notes: Actual template style observations, not an assertion that all initial submissions must use every observed property.
The template uses non-system 方正书宋_GBK; its font files are not copied or installed.
Chinese abstract/keywords are 8.5pt; English abstract/keywords are 10pt. Label and content character styles differ and require host review.

Title and upper heading Chinese glyphs use Heiti. Third-level heading uses the explicitly instructed FangZheng ShuSong_GBK 10pt. Embedded Latin digits can use a separate bold font; no uniform bold value is inferred for mixed runs.
The DOC contains MathType/OLE. Only the disabled-macro conversion and static XML/read-only format access occurred; original objects are not imported.
The first main-text introduction paragraph precedes the first numbered heading. A host role map must identify that paragraph as body_start for the measured continuous one-to-two-column boundary.
Third-level heading size follows the explicit 10pt instruction at p25, not the 8.5pt red annotation run used to display that instruction.
